single_pr_unit.instructions: Can this feature section be delivered as one pull request that a coding agent finishes in one session, with one test file and one acceptance check?

criteria.true: It is one bounded unit of work.
criteria.false: It bundles several independent changes or is too large for one PR.

depends_on_earlier.instructions: Does this feature section require an earlier section of the same spec to be implemented first?

criteria.true: It builds on code or data an earlier section introduces.
